acs.text_first_line: Scenario: AC1 The required level is read in one hop on the result date and stamped on the entry
Scenario: AC2 The version in force on the result date is the version written on the entry
Scenario: AC3 The pack shows the required level through the approval read
Scenario: AC4 An approved NLEADS result is recorded as one D5 entry before the approval moves
Scenario: AC5 A refused NLEADS result is recorded with its reason, and invalid input is refused
Scenario: AC6 A level below the level required is refused and nothing is written
Scenario: AC7 A second result or a repeated request writes no second entry
Scenario: AC8 A result that cannot be recorded does not happen
Scenario: AC9 The credit result is read back by audit within the scope
Scenario: AC10 Two callers record a result at once
